settings.title: Tap to view our full returns policy
settings.answer:
30-Day Return Policy in short

From the moment you receive your order, you have a full 30-day window to return your item(s). This period allows you to experience your William Wood product in your home and determine whether it suits your space and preferences.

Return of item(s) with damage/fault

You have 7 days from receipt of your delivery to open and assess the condition of your item(s). Given the size and fragile nature of the products we supply, damages can occur in transit. If you do not intend to use the item for a longer period of time, please inspect to confirm the physical condition of the item(s). Please contact Customer Support Team via hello@williamwoodmirrors.co.uk and advise any damage that you have found on your item(s). 

Should you find any damage or fault over a longer period of time, please contact warranty@williamwoodmirrors.co.uk

Return Policy Exclusions

All products are delivered in packaging that can be carefully opened and reused. We accept returns under the following packaging conditions, however a repackaging fee will apply when returning:

• Unboxed products

• Products returned in non-original packaging

• Original packaging returned in a condition unsuitable for reuse

Carriage Fees:

There is a £15 carriage fee for return of item(s) up to the value of £499 RRP

There is a £25 carriage fee for return of item(s) over the value of £500 RRP

Please note this charge is applied per visit.

Repackaging Fees:

·       Orders under £99 RRP: £10 fee applies

·       Orders £100 - £499 RRP: £15 fee applies

·       Orders £500 RRP and over: £25 fee applies

Are there any circumstances where I may

not return an item?

Yes, a return may not be accepted if your

product is being returned to us in a no longer ‘as new’ or is in a ‘used’ condition.

Signs of use and wear which may remove

your ability to return a product:

• You have wall mounted your mirror

• Your table displays signs of use and fair wear and tear

• Your chair displays signs of use and fair wear and tear

• Your product displays scuffs/marks obtained through fair use within your home environment

Exchanges

We offer one free exchange per order, including free collection and delivery of your new item (completed on a single visit to your property).

Should you wish to make additional

exchange beyond this, a delivery fee of £15 will apply for each subsequent exchange.

Exchange to Pre Order item(s)

Should you wish to exchange to a pre-order product, this shall take place throughout the advised pre-order week. If you did wish for the original item to be collected prior to the date advised, a £15.00 carriage fee will apply.

Exchange of Free Gifts

For exchanges of free gift items, a £15 carriage fee will apply.

Returning Orders Containing a Free Gift

If your order included a free gift

item, you may retain the free gift when partially returning your order, provided the

remaining order value still meets the minimum threshold required to qualify for

the free gift.

If after a return, your order value falls

below this threshold, the free gift must either:

1. Be returned with your returning items

or

2. Payment made equivalent to item price as stated at the time of your original order

(this amount may be deducted from your refund).

Returns on Discounted Bundle Orders

If you return part of an order that was

placed using a multi-item bundle discount, the remaining items in your order will be re-evaluated under the relevant offer tier. For example:

• If a “30% off three or more full priced items” promotion was used, and one item is returned, the remaining two items will be adjusted to the “25% off two full priced items” pricing.

• The price difference will be deducted from your refund

 Promotional Code Misuse or Reuse

Our promotional codes are updated

frequently to give customers the best possible value. If you have already

received your order and wish to return your item(s) solely to repurchase them

using a different promotional code, a £15 return carriage fee will apply.

United Kingdom

We do not charge a fee for delivery to the UK.

settings.title: I want to exchange my order
settings.answer:
Should you wish to exchange your order for another item, this service is free within up to 30 days of your order being received. Should the product you wish to exchange to be higher in price than the initial product on your order, the difference in price will be requested by our Customer Support Team. Should the product you wish to exchange to be lower in price than the initial product on your order, an exchange will be carried out. Once the initial product is returned back to our warehouse, the difference in price will be refunded back to you as soon as possible. Please note your first exchange is free. Any additional exchanges which are not a result of a product being faulty are charged at a fixed fee of £15.00.

International Orders: Due to customs regulations and duties on international orders, we are unable to process exchanges for alternative items on existing orders. Instead, we will be required to cancel your current order, allowing you to place a new one with your preferred items.

settings.title: I want to return my order
settings.answer:
There is a £15 carriage fee for return of item(s) up to the value of £499 RRP

There is a £25 carriage fee for return of item(s) over the value of £500 RRP

Please note this charge is applied per visit.

You have 30 days from receipt of delivery to confirm the suitability of your item(s). Should any of your order not be suitable, please contact our Customer Support Team via hello@williamwoodmirrors.co.uk

Please do not worry about returning item(s) yourself, returning item(s) are collected by William Wood Dedicated Delivery. Once your return has been confirmed, we will contact you by telephone to arrange collection. 

Please keep your packaging until you have confirmed you are 100% happy with your order.

settings.title: I want to cancel my order
settings.answer: You retain full control of your order with us at all times. Please contact hello@williamwoodmirrors.co.uk and our Customer Support Team will be happy to assist you. If you wish to cancel your order whilst out it's out for delivery, we can only refund your purchase once the cancelled item(s) have been received back at our warehouse.

We're leading the way in our industry and believe our customers should not have to wait long periods to receive their funds back. Therefore, rest assured your order will be refunded as soon as it is collected.

Contact us via hello@williamwoodmirrors.co.uk and our Customer Support Team
will be more than happy to assist.
